The '''Bendu Village''' was a settlement occupied by the [[Order of Dai Bendu]] who dwelled in the [[Andobi Mountains/Legends|Andobi Mountains]] of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. That modest village consisted of a few [[Tent/Legends|tents]] clustered around a central [[Stone/Legends|stone]] [[Bendu Statue|colossus]].
